what: Doctest examples took their source root ids by arithmetic on `Crates::sets` (`sets + 1` and up), so nothing else could ever add a source root after the first plan without colliding with them; found only by grepping for `.sets`.
cost: one redesign of the id allocation mid-change
cause: two allocators of one id space, the second derived from the first's count
whys: the first plan's roots were `0..sets` and `other`, fixed for the database's life
doctests needed roots later and took the numbers after
prevention: `Graph::root` is the one allocator of source root ids in blaze-lower; doctests call it (`RootOf::Example`)
fix: written in this lane (not yet built)
state: open until the round's build and tests pass
